title: Concept: Content security policy allows eval
description: A policy that grants unsafe-eval to scripts in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Eval turns any string the page can influence into code, so the policy stops being a defence against injection through string concatenation.
applicability: Deployments that render a policy that grants unsafe-eval to scripts into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Eval turns any string the page can influence into code, so the policy stops being a defence against injection through string concatenation.
